about: Run-through banners (PreMatchVignette). Each text is 2-4 lines, at most 28 characters a line once filled in (24 or fewer reads best at 360 px). Fill-ins: {us}/{them} = club nicknames (Magpies, Kangaroos), {player} = a surname, {games} = his game count, {year}. Light-hearted cheer-squad rhymes: rivals get ribbed, nobody gets abused. ANZAC Day and Dreamtime banners honour the day and taunt no one. Picked by Banners.pick.
